recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-11479 unless the Pharmacy work group wants a separate future editorial cleanup of the existing sentence.
issue_request: FHIR-11479 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core Pharmacy issue raised against DSTU2. It asked to include planning or recommendation of drug use as a Medication module use case and perhaps reference CarePlan; the accepted resolution said the Common Use Cases section would be reviewed and updated, with other use cases such as care plan included as appropriate.
initial_application: Jira comments say Melva Peters updated the UseCase section in SVN build @9953. Git commit 63eb75e588d983403821e1088dd962e1e9227cf4, whose message is "#11481 and #11479 - updated Medications Module" and whose git-svn-id is build@9953, added the Common Use Cases bullet for "Retrieving the planned medication therapy" and linked intended therapy to an individual Care Plan. The same commit also removed the unrelated "Correcting errors" boilerplate for FHIR-11481.
additional_context: source/medications-module.html is in build scope through source/hierarchy.xml, which lists it as the Medications module page with active medication and immunization child resources. Later R6 page work for FHIR-53486 reordered and corrected the Common Use Cases section but preserved this planned-therapy bullet; FHIR-53486 is already represented on the combined branch. Direct Zulip and Confluence searches for FHIR-11479 found no conflicting discussion, and a Jira neighborhood search for the planning/CarePlan terms returned only FHIR-11479.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because current build-scoped source already satisfies the issue request.

related_jiras.note: The same 2016 source commit also removed the distinct "Correcting errors" boilerplate requested by FHIR-11481, which is already represented on the combined branch.
